title: Bones, Artboards, Punctuation, Caramel & Boiling Ink
description: A mesh bound to bones, an artboard made of real DOM, self-correcting punctuation, a selection that flows, and outlines redrawn by hand.

drops.title: Bones That Bend the Drawing
drops.description: Bind every outline point to a chain of joints by distance, move the joints, and the artwork deforms with them.
drops.concept: Rigby2d is a 2D skeletal animation editor: art is bound to bones, and the bones do the animating. The web version of that idea is linear blend skinning — each silhouette vertex keeps an inverse-rest transform per joint and a distance-based weight, so the skinned point is a weighted sum of the same point seen from every bone. Dragging a tip runs the chain the other way with cyclic coordinate descent, clamped per joint so nothing snaps.
drops.source: jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d — open-source 2D skeletal animation editor (AutoRig, mesh deformation)

interaction.mouse: Drag any creature; the nearest tip chases the pointer and the mesh follows
interaction.click: Toggle the skeleton and the per-vertex weight colours; falloff rebinds the weights live
interaction.touch: Same drag gesture with pointer events; the panel hides on small screens

drops.title: The Artboard Is a Page
drops.description: Layers are real DOM, so the canvas lays out exactly like the build — and edits land in a shared class, not on one box.
drops.concept: Kalka is a design tool whose layers are HTML and CSS rather than vectors: every artboard is a page the browser lays out, so flex and grid behave on the canvas as they will in production. The consequence this drop isolates is that editing is rule-level — change .k-card's radius and all three cards move. Resizing the board drives a container query so the preview reacts to the board, not the window, while the exported rules are plain @media.
drops.source: leyscore/kalka — design editor whose canvas is real HTML and CSS

interaction.mouse: Click a layer on the artboard or a row in the layer tree to select its rule
interaction.click: Padding, radius, gap and direction edit the rule — every layer wearing it moves
interaction.touch: The board slider resizes the artboard; under 560px the phone variant takes over

drops.title: The Text Fixes Its Own Punctuation
drops.description: Nine ordered passes turn ASCII into real typography, and a character-level diff marks every glyph that moved.
drops.concept: Punctilio converts straight quotes, double hyphens and ASCII symbols into their typographic forms as a sequence of ordered, idempotent passes. Order is the whole game: primes run before quotes so 5'10" stays a height, and non-breaking spaces go in last so honorifics, units and the final word of a line never break. Switching locale swaps the quote pair — and French adds the thin space inside its guillemets.
drops.source: AlexanderMattTurner/punctilio — typography library for English text (smart quotes, dashes, primes, nbsp)

interaction.mouse: Type in the left pane and the right pane re-typesets on every keystroke
interaction.click: Toggle any pass off to see what it was doing; switch locale for US, UK, German or French quotes
interaction.touch: Three sample texts load with one tap; the output pane fills the screen on phones

drops.title: The Selection Flows Like Syrup
drops.description: A blurred layer behind the buttons plus an alpha threshold: blobs that pass near each other merge with a visible neck.
drops.concept: Caramel Pudding animates the selected colour of a button row as a liquid that flows from the old option to the new one. The trick is a goo layer behind the buttons — blurred, then pushed through an alpha threshold so near shapes fuse. Neighbours stretch across both seats and settle with a bulge; a distant jump necks thin and launches a droplet that is reabsorbed. Presses use the matching pudding squash: scale down, then a decaying squash-and-stretch release.
drops.source: wave2234/caramel-pudding — jelly press and gooey caramel selection, one file, zero dependencies

interaction.mouse: Pick options near and far — adjacent moves stretch, distant ones throw a droplet
interaction.click: Press and hold any option to feel the pudding squash; release for the bounce
interaction.touch: Press is delayed 70ms and cancelled by a 10px drag so scrolling never squashes a button

drops.title: Components That Boil
drops.description: Every outline is an SVG path walked around a rounded rect with seeded jitter, swapped between frames seven times a second.
drops.concept: PlopUI is a component kit drawn in one marker on cream paper: wobbly borders, crooked stickers, ink bursts on press. The mechanism is seeded randomness plus a boil — a handful of pre-drawn frames cycling a few times a second, which is what makes a still line look alive. Because the jitter comes from a seeded PRNG rather than Math.random, the server and the client draw the identical crooked box, and tilt is seeded the same way.
drops.source: Snorlark/plop-ui — hand-drawn React UI kit, imperfect on purpose (useBoil, seededTilt, useInkBurst)

interaction.mouse: Press any button for an ink burst; tick the checkboxes to see the hand-drawn mark draw itself
interaction.click: Pour a toast, or re-roll the seeds to redraw every outline in the kit
interaction.touch: Wobble, boil rate and frame count are sliders; reduced motion freezes the boil
